text:
A 10/10 Dental Experience in Koh Samui
​I had been putting off much-needed dental work, hoping to get it done affordably in Thailand. I was even told by another clinic that getting two crowns done in my two-week timeframe wouldn't be possible. Thankfully, I found Chaweng Dental and was completely blown away by the service.
​From the moment I walked in, I was met with professionalism and genuine care. Dr. Nuntida Lorprasertkul and Dr. Watchara Suksong were incredible. They were not only meticulous and highly skilled but also spoke fluent English, which made everything so much easier. They assured me that I could get all the work I needed done within my two-week trip.
​What started as needing two crowns turned into a full mouth transformation. I ended up getting three crowns, four fillings, a deep clean, and a whitening treatment. The most unbelievable part? The total cost was the same price I was quoted for just two crowns back in Australia.
​The entire experience was a pleasure. The staff were fantastic, and I honestly looked forward to my daily appointments. This was, without a doubt, the most positive dental experience I have ever had. If you're in Koh Samui and need a top-notch dentist, don't look anywhere else. The entire team at Chaweng Dental gets a 10 out of 10 from me!🦷💯

text: Like most people, I'm not exactly a big fan of visiting a dentist, especially in another country. But Dr. Nuntida changed my mind. She speaks very good English, and also knows how to listen. Another thing that I like is that she's not trying to force anything on you and saying openly that some things are most likely unnecessary at this point (wisdom teeth removal and a crown on one of the molars). The clinic itself is clean and neat. It also well-equipped: they have portable x-ray and panoramic x-ray. They also readily send the scans to your e-mail or messenger. Pricing is also seems adequate. All in all the place leaves a good impression of an establishment where people know what they are doing. If you happened to need a dentist attention during your stay on Samui, pay Dr. Nuntida a visit — even if only for a consultation. Adequate evaluation of your situation is a crucial first step.
